The dwarven miners may have left traces of what they extracted. Go down into the northernmost mine outside Kazordoon, fight your way through {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} and {creature:Bat|Bats} to the northwest and open the chest to receive an {item:Iron Ore}.
The dwarven miners may have left traces of the materials they mined.
The {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} can be dangerous for very low levels: bring some health potions.

The {wiki:Dwarf Mines} are **west** (and below) of **Kazordoon**. Leave the city and go on foot **west**, over the surface: there are 6 mine entrances around the mountain. The one you want is the **northernmost**, the yellow mine (A, *Old Ore Mine*) on the wiki maps.
